title: GuardianAgentFlow: Multi-Agent Coordination for Web Privacy Protection
abstract: arXiv:2611.15097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Web agents need to use private context without unnecessarily disclosing it. Effective protection must distinguish between requests that may be sent after sanitization and those that must be withheld, while preserving the information needed for authorized tasks. We present GuardianAgentFlow, a multi-agent framework that mediates outgoing Web requests through an explicit release contract. A dedicated restriction check grounds permission in the user's instruction; a shared protection scope aligns rewriting with disclosure checking; and candidate-grounded feedback guides revision before transmission. Experiments on Web requests with human-reviewed intent labels show improved request-contract success, while controlled comparisons and role ablations identify the contributions of restriction handling, policy evidence, and candidate checking. translated_title: GuardianAgentFlow：用于网络隐私保护的多智能体协作框架
translated_abstract: 网络智能体需要在不过度泄露私人上下文的前提下使用私密信息。有效的隐私保护必须区分哪些请求可以在净化后发送、哪些请求必须予以扣留，同时保留授权任务所需的信息。我们提出了 GuardianAgentFlow，这是一个通过明确的发布契约来管控外发 Web 请求的多智能体框架。其中，专门的限制检查将许可建立在用户指令的基础上；共享的保护范围使重写与披露检查保持一致；基于候选请求的反馈在传输前引导修订。在带有人工审核意图标签的 Web 请求上的实验表明，请求-契约成功率有所提升；受控对比实验和角色消融实验明确了限制处理、政策证据和候选检查各自的贡献。对来自 PrivacyLens 和 AgentDAM 的动作建议的评估显示，该框架能够提供互补性的保护。
tldr: GuardianAgentFlow 是一个多智能体框架，通过明确的发布契约协调限制检查、共享保护范围和基于候选请求的反馈，在完成授权任务的同时有效管控外发网络请求中的隐私泄露。
en_tdlr: GuardianAgentFlow is a multi-agent framework that mediates outgoing web requests through an explicit release contract, coordinating restriction checks, shared protection scopes, and candidate-grounded feedback to protect privacy while preserving task-relevant information.
